_provenance.source: Enchantments Traverse Planner app asset assets/map/contours-ft.json, built by scripts/build-contours.py --feet from AWS Open Data terrain tiles (Terrarium encoding), clipped to a buffer around the mapped traverse and Douglas-Peucker simplified. 100 ft interval.
_provenance.note: Modeled terrain from a public DEM, not a survey. Supports reading the shape of the ground; not a claim about any measured height. Copied to the website 2026-09-28.
